patch_description: A compact contextual bandit scheduler: it keeps a hard clone-biased baseline in stable ecology, then allocates a small mutation budget only when observable stress, low intake, decline, or death pressure rises. Operator success is used as a bounded advantage over clone, with evidence and under-use shaping which mutation class receives the budget. This should reduce sham-world mutation cost while still allowing conservative/standard rescue mutations after persistent injury creates measurable ecological stress.
